March 25 1971: Tale of the Darkest Night
2014-12-08T00:02:22+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/march-25-1971-tale-of-the-darkest-night-54455

In this documentary Tale of the Darkest Night, relatives and victims give their account on the night between March 25 and 26 when the Pakistani army conducted mass murder in East Pakistan (now Bangladesh). All day on March 26, the killings went on. This documentary is based on the genocide in Dhaka University Campus. The video was shared on YouTube by the channel of AmarBoi (URL: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sd3JFYl5ZcY)
